text:
alex: Proposing new 'siem_custodian' role + KMS unwrap rotation for forensic SIEM exports. Want a short playbook we can land before the retention change rollout?

maria: SGTM. Quick Q — retention bump still 180 -> 400 days for selected datasets?

alex: Yes, only for compliance/evidence buckets. Key pieces: timeboxed SIEM export leases, dual-approval unwrap, and audit entries for every unwrap. Draft idea below.

jamal: Concern: analysts currently request ad-hoc s3 dumps. We need migration steps so triage isn't blocked during cutover.

leo: oncall-bot: scheduled deploy window booked Tue 02:00 UTC — will run staging test of KMS rotation and export flow.

maria: We should force ticket ID and approver metadata into the audit log (CMK id, approver, justification). Also require a simple redaction pass for PII on any export that will live >90d.

alex: Draft playbook snippet:
```
1) Analyst requests export -> opens ticket with dataset, time window, justification, TTL, approvers.
2) Request goes to 2 approvers (security + owner).
3) If approved, KMS-proxy mints ephemeral unwrap token (TTL=24h) via Vault/STS.
4) Export service pulls, applies redact schema, writes to protected bucket with retention tag.
5) Log unwrap event: cmk=projects/…/keys/…, approvers=[u1,u2], ticket=URL, ttl=24h
```

jamal: Sounds good. For migration: add a shim that rewrites existing team s3 requests to the new flow and returns a short-lived download link so analysts aren't blocked. We should also capture old exports to backfill audit metadata.

leo: I'll own the migration script + smoke tests. Plan: dry-run in staging, run backfill job, then flip routing. Rollback: revert routing and revoke any active unwrap tokens.

maria: Also add detection rules: if a single principal requests >10GB exports/day or >5 unwraps/day, fire a security ops alert. That helps detect exfil patterns. :rotating_light:

alex: Agree. I'll add metric thresholds and an alert runbook to the PR. tagging @security-eng for review and then I'll open a change request doc (link will be added). Thanks all :thumbsup:

security-eng: Noted — will review playbook and confirm RBAC matrix for 'siem_custodian' (dual-approval) vs 'siem_analyst' (read-only). We'll also validate CMK rotation cadence and ensure auditors can see unwrap audit trail.
